api:
<TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| a * b + c} corners={names} levels={8} />
PropTypeDefault
fieldFn(f64, f64, f64) -> f64: the value at each composition; the parts add up to 1required
cornersas on <Ternary>A, B, C
resolutionusize: mesh steps per side (2–200)30
levelsusize: contour lines8
schemeHeatmapSchemeViridis
meshbool: draw the mesh triangle edgesfalse

The triangle is split into resolution² small triangles, each coloured by the mean of its corners. Contours are traced through the mesh with marching triangles. A colour scale sits on the right. The field is evaluated once per change of these props.

examples.title: A single peak
examples.description: A field over the triangle with eight contour levels; hover a cell for its value.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn peak() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| (-((a - 0.5).powi(2) + (b - 0.3).powi(2) + (c - 0.2).powi(2)) * 12.).exp()} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Mixing energy
examples.description: An entropy-like surface over a three-metal alloy.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn mixing_energy() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| [a, b, c].iter().map(|x| if *x > 0. { x * x.ln() } else { 0. }).sum::<f64>() + 1.5 * a * b} corners={corners(["Fe", "Ni", "Cr"])} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Plasma} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Visible mesh
examples.description: A 12-step mesh with its triangle edges drawn.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn mesh_lines() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, _: f64| a * b} resolution={12} mesh={true} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Fine mesh
examples.code:
#[component]
fn fine() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| (a * 9.).sin() + (b * 7.).cos() + c} resolution={80} levels={12} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Turbo} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: No contours
examples.description: levels 0 keeps only the colour mesh.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn no_lines() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, _: f64, c: f64| a - c} levels={0} scheme={HeatmapScheme::RdBu} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Concrete strength
examples.description: A response surface for three binders.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn strength() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| 30. * a + 45. * b + 20. * c + 60. * a * b - 25. * b * c} corners={corners(["Cement", "Slag", "Fly ash"])} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Greens} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: A ridge
examples.code:
#[component]
fn ridge() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, _: f64| (-(a - b).powi(2) * 30.).exp()} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Inferno} levels={5} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Two peaks
examples.code:
#[component]
fn two_peaks() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| (-((a - 0.7).powi(2) + (c - 0.1).powi(2)) * 25.).exp() + (-((b - 0.6).powi(2) + (c - 0.3).powi(2)) * 25.).exp()} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Cividis} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Coarse
examples.code:
#[component]
fn coarse() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| a * b * c} resolution={8} mesh={true} levels={3} scheme={HeatmapScheme::Oranges} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Melting temperature
examples.code:
#[component]
fn melting() {
    rsx! { <TernaryContour field={|a: f64, b: f64, c: f64| 1400. * a + 1100. * b + 900. * c - 600. * a * b - 400. * b * c - 300. * a * c} corners={corners(["Fo", "An", "Di"])} scheme={HeatmapScheme::YlOrRd} class="h-96" /> }
}
